verdict.rationale: Audit logging of flag changes is a fair question for a feature-flag platform like Statsig, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log recording who changed a gate, when, or to which value. The nearby material does not qualify: gate exposure monitoring tracks which users encounter a gate, not who edited it, and SSO/SCIM and the Console API CRUD endpoints are separate features.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
